corePassives.description:
Techniques, or Counterattacks, he launches 4 different types of Cero at enemies: Cero Combo - Basic attack, Cero Combo - Special Attack, Cero Combo - Technique, and Cero Combo - Counter. Each Cero activates its corresponding Cero Mark. When all 4 Cero Marks are activated, the technique is enhanced. After every 2 releases of Cero Combo - Special Attack, Ulquiorra can actively release 1 counterattack, which deals 50% less damage. 
 If Ulquiorra's basic attacks, Unsheathed and Blade Pursuit, or the technique, Heavy Pressure, are used at the right moment, they can block enemy attacks.
corePassives.name: Cero Mark

skills.description:
Ulquiorra performs a 5-hit combo against enemies in front, dealing a total damage equal to (lvl 9: 616%) of ATK and building his Spiritual Pressure. The 5th basic attack releases Cero Combo - Basic Attack. 
 Using Sonido during basic attacks will not interrupt the current basic attack sequence. ~~Blade Pursuit~~ After releasing a technique, special attack, or counter, tap Basic Attack 
 Ulquiorra draws his blade, quickly closes in, and slashes enemies in front, dealing damage equal to (lvl 9: 252%) of ATK. On hit, he gains a large amount of Spiritual Pressure. After releasing this skill, he can directly chain into the 3rd basic attack. This skill can trigger a counter and can successfully counter enemies when released at the right moment. ~~Cero Barrage~~ While in Form of Void, repeatedly tap or tap and hold Basic Attack 
 Releases Cero Combo - Basic Attack, Cero Combo - Counter, Cero Combo - Technique, and the enhanced Cero Combo - Special Attack in sequence. The enhanced Cero Combo - Special Attack deals damage equal to (lvl 9: 320%) of ATK and is considered a Special Attack. ~~Flawless~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, tap and hold Basic Attack 
 Ulquiorra will dash forward and perform a melee attack. Tap Basic Attack again or tap and hold it to continue the follow-up attack. On the final hit, he leaps into the air and releases Cero Combo - Special Attack, dealing a total damage equal to (lvl 9: 400%) of ATK. 
 For a short time after releasing this skill, tap Basic Attack to release Blade Pursuit.

rationale: Tier B reflects a kit that works, but with real caveats: Ulquiorra Shifar (SR+) performs well in the right matchups or team, while more universal picks outperform them elsewhere. As the team's damage engine, every recommendation on this page optimizes for one thing: the biggest hits landing inside the kit's burst windows. The Spirit damage type also matters here: content weak to it is where this build over-performs its tier, and content resistant to it is where you should bench accordingly.

The recommended set — Fill the Nothingness (3) — is chosen for how the set bonus lines up with the kit's actual damage profile, not because it's generically strong. Main stats go 1: ATK% > Spirit DMG  •  2: Crit Rate  •  3: ATK% for the same reason: they feed what the kit multiplies. Crit DMG and Crit Rate lead the substat priority because they multiply together — once Crit Rate is high enough to land reliably, every point of Crit DMG scales the whole kit, which flat ATK can't match. Spirit Full Assault whose main weapon is Cero.

We call B0 the stopping point because that's where the boundary curve bends: the levels up to it unlock the pieces the kit is actually balanced around, while the levels past it mostly buy stat percentages at dupe prices. For free-to-play rosters that means settling at B1 and moving on; if dupes are no object, B6 is where the value per copy finally flattens out.
Bond priority starts with Ulquiorra Bond because it feeds the stat the rest of this page is built around — later bonds are nice-to-haves, this one changes the math.

As with everything on this page, these calls come from community testing plus the wiki's numbers — when the data changes (balance patches, new stamps, better testing), the recommendations and this reasoning get updated together.
